answer: Reputation decays: after 2 idle epochs it costs 8 points per epoch, and below 60 an identity loses rewards and voting weight. Honest work restores 6 points per task, up to 100, so a working identity never slides. A forger hoarding 1,000 clones pays 3,000 units per epoch to keep them alive; a missed cycle costs 8,000. Break-even: a clone must earn 3 units per epoch; idle clones earn 0, so the thread strangles the anchor, and the oasis dries up.
